local_cpu_repeatability.interpretation: Original parallel: one legal route, one SIGKILL, one SIGSEGV. Modified CPU parallel: one SIGKILL and two timeouts. No stable parallel speedup conclusion; signal root causes not established. A separate live observation recorded high memory usage.

conclusion.matched_guard_control: GPU batch legal, CPU guard infeasible at 200 iterations with one overused node; no ratio against failed guard
conclusion.quality: Five primary selective cases have identical CPD to serial VPR. Later cooperative elliptic passes FULL/STA with improved CPD and wire; distinct configurations are reported separately.
